description: This file defines a custom SwiftUI view modifier named StatusGlassCardModifier used to style views with a semi-transparent, glass-like appearance and shadows, and an extension on View to apply this modifier conveniently.

classes.name: StatusGlassCardModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that adds padding, a semi-transparent rounded rectangle background with border and shadow effects to a view.

methods.name: statusGlassCard
methods.description: An extension method on View for applying the StatusGlassCardModifier with specified parameters.
